name: Viridescent Dragon: Chapter 3
source:
Charlotte and Dawn travel to Laseaux to retrieve Queen Tempest and search for Seleste. The Violean Army and many people from around the world will be there for the annual Mach Ball game and the Lady Margaux's coming of age ceremony. What trials will our sea-faring adventurers face yet?

[From [url=https://viridea.itch.io/viridescent-dragon-chapter-3]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
夏洛特和道恩前往拉索寻找暴风雨女王并寻找塞莱斯特。紫罗兰军团和来自世界各地的许多人将出席一年一度的马赫球赛和玛歌夫人的成年典礼。我们的航海冒险家又将面临怎样的考验呢？

[来自[url=https://viridea.itch.io/viridescent-dragon-chapter-3]Itch.io[/url]]
